title: The Empty Housing | Nat 20 Pixels C1E3
description:
Lantern Thirty-Seven burned for three hundred years and went out in a single night. Today the party walks out to find out why.
A lantern cannot simply go out. So what happened to this one?

Episode 3 of a daily pixel-art D&D 5e story. Brannoc, Ilsevel, Tamsin and Oriel walk the Lantern Road to the dead lantern, where the grass has turned grey in broad daylight and the glass is cold to the touch. A frozen lock, a scholar's eye, a soldier reading the ground at dusk: every check is decided by real, seeded dice shown on screen, with no rerolls.

New episode every weekday. Characters, quotes and every roll are on the wiki.
